home.description: «Berehynja» is a Ukrainian space in Germany created for children, teenagers, and adults who were forced to find themselves far from home. We bring Ukrainian families together, help preserve their language, culture, and traditions, and support those who are going through the process of adaptation and integration into a new environment.
home.title: Welcome to «Berehynja»!

about.teamContent: Our team consists of dedicated volunteers and professionals who are committed to making a difference in the lives of Ukrainians in Germany. We work together to create a supportive environment where everyone can feel at home.

cookie.title: Privacy notice
cookie.description: We use only technically necessary local storage to ensure that the website functions properly and remembers your language selection. External services such as YouTube and Google Maps are loaded only after your explicit action.
cookie.necessary_desc: This storage is used for essential website functionality and to remember your language selection. It is not used for advertising, analytics or tracking.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Protecting your data is a high priority for us. We process personal data confidentially, transparently and only for specified purposes in accordance with the GDPR and applicable German data protection law.
privacy.empty: The information is currently being updated.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.desc: Berehynja e.V. is responsible for processing personal data on this website. The association determines the purposes and means of processing personal data. Detailed contact and registration information is available in our legal notice.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure and hosting
infrastructure.desc: We use technical infrastructure provided by Firebase, a Google service, for certain functions of this website. Depending on the services used and their configuration, data may be processed by Google and its subprocessors. Processing is governed by the applicable contractual arrangements and data protection requirements.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.desc: We use only technically necessary cookies or browser local storage, particularly to remember the selected language and provide essential website functions. Marketing or analytics tracking is not used unless it is identified separately and activated on an appropriate legal basis.

info.label: Access
info.desc: You have the right to know whether we process your personal data, what data is stored, the purposes for which it is used and the recipients to whom it may be disclosed.

correction.label: Rectification
correction.desc: You have the right to request the correction of inaccurate personal data and the completion of incomplete information.

deletion.label: Erasure
deletion.desc: You have the right to request the erasure of personal data when it is no longer needed for the relevant purposes and there are no lawful grounds for continued retention.

objection.label: Objection
objection.desc: Subject to the conditions of Article 21 GDPR, you have the right to object to processing based on a legitimate interest.

media.title: External media services
media.cloudinaryDesc: Cloudinary is used to store, optimize and deliver images and media files. When such content is retrieved, technical data, particularly the IP address, may be transmitted to Cloudinary.
media.youtubeDesc: YouTube videos may be embedded on this website. When privacy-enhanced mode is used, data is generally transmitted to YouTube only after the user interacts with the video. The precise processing depends on the actual embedding method.

complaint.title: Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.desc: Under Article 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority if you believe that the processing of your personal data infringes data protection law.

generalProcessing.title: General information about processing
generalProcessing.default: We process personal data only to the extent necessary to operate this website, handle requests, organize our services and fulfil our statutory purposes. Processing is carried out in accordance with the GDPR and other applicable data protection laws.

contactForms.title: Contact forms and registrations
contactForms.default: When a contact or registration form is submitted, we may process your name, email address, telephone number, selected program or event, message content, submission date and time, and any information provided voluntarily. The data is used to process the request, organize participation and communicate with you afterwards.

automation.title: Automated transmission using n8n
automation.default: We use a self-hosted n8n instance for the technical transmission, allocation and structured processing of form data. Required information is automatically forwarded to destination systems selected by us. We do not make decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects solely by automated means.

vpsHosting.title: Self-hosted n8n and VPS server
vpsHosting.default: The n8n software is operated by us on a rented virtual private server. Form data is not transferred to the n8n software provider to run the automation. The VPS provider may process data on our behalf when operating, maintaining and securing the server infrastructure. System access is restricted to authorized persons.

googleWorkspace.title: Google Workspace and Google Sheets
googleWorkspace.default: Submitted information may be stored in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, to manage, allocate and track requests internally. Google processes this data on our behalf. Transfers outside the European Economic Area take place only using safeguards recognized by the GDPR.

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.default: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose. Request data is deleted or anonymized after the defined period unless statutory retention obligations apply or the data is required to establish or defend legal claims.

userRights.title: Your rights
userRights.default: You have the right to access, rectify or erase your data, restrict or object to processing and, where provided by law, receive your data in a portable format. Consent may be withdrawn at any time with future effect.

mission.title: The Mission of Berehynja
mission.subtitle: Support and understanding
mission.lead: We want every Ukrainian family to feel that they are not alone and have support and a place where they are understood.
mission.text: Berehynja is more than an association. It is a small piece of Ukraine in the heart of Europe. We created this space so people could have a place of their own: a place to speak their native language, celebrate traditional holidays, introduce children to Ukrainian culture and experience the warmth of a community. Everyone can find something here: support, personal development, friendship or simply a calm and welcoming environment.

children.title: For children
children.subtitle: Development and education
children.lead: We maintain a connection with Ukraine and help children develop new skills.
children.text: Our classes and programmes help children and teenagers maintain their connection with Ukraine while living abroad. We teach Ukrainian language and culture and support the development of thinking, creativity, self-confidence and teamwork skills.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Meetings and events
community.lead: We create a sense of belonging through communication and shared experiences.
community.text: We place particular emphasis on bringing families together through meetings, workshops, events and cultural activities. This is how a strong, welcoming and supportive community develops.

adults.title: For parents
adults.subtitle: Support and integration
adults.lead: Advice and support for integration in Germany.
adults.text: For adults, we organise consultations, information meetings and integration support so that everyone can build their life in Germany more confidently. We understand the challenges of adapting to a new environment and are ready to help at every stage.

summary.title: Berehynja
summary.subtitle: A place of warmth and support
summary.lead: A place where children grow, parents receive support and the community becomes stronger.
summary.text: Berehynja is a place where we preserve what connects us to Ukraine. We want everyone who enters our space to feel warmth, safety and confidence that they are not alone. This gives children stability and helps them adapt more easily to school and their new surroundings.
